latest.title: Amazon S3 Bucket – Introduction
latest.description: Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) is an AWS cloud storage service used to store and manage data such as files, images, videos, and documents. An S3 bucket is a container where these objects are stored. S3 provides secure, scalable, and highly durable storage that can be accessed from anywhere through the internet

trending.title: A Physical AI Robot Episode Judge That Knows When It Does Not Know: Strands Decider in Strands Robots
trending.description: I added Strands Decider as an opt-in episode-judge backend in strands-labs/robots. It labels a recorded robot episode with one HTTP request (about 1.8 s), returns calibrated probabilities, and writes a label only when it is confident. On a 12-episode MuJoCo test it wrote zero wrong labels and left every unsure episode, with its probabilities, for the existing VLM judge.

trending.title: How I Trained the Best 2B Strands Decider: Beating the Official Strands Model and the 2B Leaders, Top 3 in Text, Image and Multimodal
trending.description: I unlocked image input in Strands Decider, then trained four 2B-class checkpoints that beat the published v19 and, by my estimate, take the top 3 spots on the 2B text board, #2 on images and the best text+image slot. This is the full engineering story: the benchmark rules, a 27B yes/no teacher, a base-model bake-off, a calibration fix, a text+image model that broke and was repaired, and an unseen-task check against the 2B leaders. All scores are local and unofficial.
